name: Seven Eleven Hotel Baku
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at Seven Eleven Hotel Baku


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: Seven Eleven Hotel Baku in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and city views. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free WiFi.

Dining Experience: Guests can enjoy a traditional restaurant serving halal meals with local specialities, warm dishes, fresh pastries, and a variety of beverages. Breakfast options include a buffet, Italian, full English/Irish, and halal.

Convenient Services: The hotel provides private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and a tour desk. Additional amenities include a minimarket, coffee shop, and hairdresser.

Prime Location: Located 24 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport, the hotel is a short walk from Fountains Square and near attractions such as Maiden Tower and the Azerbaijan Carpet Museum. An ice-skating rink is also nearby.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. Children 18 years and above will be charged as adults at this property. To see correct prices and occupancy information, please add the number of children in your group and their ages to your search. Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 3 years Cot always available The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property.
